question: Does the default exact numerical path qualify for hot inference in the input-free decayed-state regime where R118-D exceeded the A=1,024 target, and what are the dispositions of the exact, guarded and flush-to-zero modes?
pre_registration_disclosure: Development runs before this registration, in the same session and VM: (1) reproduction of the R118-D diagnostic (EXACT_R118 block p95 22.2 ms at A=1,024, SMALL, steps 2,250-2,750); (2) forensic census (instrumented replica bit-identical to the native kernel) and per-operation microbenchmark; (3) kernel differential test suite; (4) one smoke run on the SMALL failure trajectory: EXACT_GUARDED bit-identical to EXACT_R118 at 4,000/4,000 steps, max 250-step-block p95 3.64 ms vs 24.43 ms. Registered measurements below are new runs.

modes.EXACT_R118: frozen R118 kernel (csrc/awr_kernel.c sha256 87b53392...), default floating-point environment
modes.EXACT_GUARDED: R119 kernel (csrc/awr_kernel_r119.c), guards SOFTMAX|GATES|CLAMP|RADIAL, default floating-point environment
modes.FTZ_DAZ: frozen R118 kernel with flush-to-zero and denormals-are-zero set for the duration of the kernel call (opt-in)
modes.STATE_FLUSH_2P-500: negative control for the numerical classification only: EXACT_R118 followed by flushing every touched relation coordinate with |x| < 2^-500 to +0

registry: STRESS1M of PROTOCOL_R118D (50,000 participants, 1,000,000 relations, 50,000 instances, arity 2-6, Zipf 0.5, seed 11803): the maximum registered relation capacity. Window extraction and initial-state seeding exactly as R118-D.

controlled_regimes.construction: registry-wide seeded N(0,1) states (PCG64 seed 118500) multiplied by the regime scale; MIXED draws one log10 scale per relation row uniformly in [-320, 0] (PCG64 seed 119500)
controlled_regimes.configuration: R114 on 54007/STATE8_SIGNED8, 1 pass, MEAN (the R118-D primary configuration)
controlled_regimes.per_step: fresh uniform random active set (PCG64 seed 119000 + 10 * regime_index + size_index), identical for all modes; every mode starts the step from the regime snapshot (touched rows restored, untimed); modes interleaved within each step

organic_trajectories.STRESS1M: fixed uniform random active set of A instances (A = 64, 256, 1,024; PCG64 seed 119100 + A), R104 on 54007/STATE8 (the R118-D failure configuration), registry-wide N(0,1) initial states, 4,000 steps, one independent state per mode, every step timed
organic_trajectories.SMALL: the R118-D failure fixture: SMALL registry of PROTOCOL_R118D, all 1,024 instances active, R104 on 54007/STATE8, 4,000 steps, every step timed

latency_metrics: nearest-rank p50, p95, p99 and max per cell; organic: overall p50/p95/p99 and the maximum p95 over 250-step blocks
latency_admission: A mode is latency-qualified iff for every active size: p95 <= target in every controlled regime AND the maximum 250-step-block p95 <= target in every organic trajectory with that active size (SMALL counts as A = 1,024), with zero refused or failed steps.

numerical_verification.bit_identity: uint64 bit patterns (so -0.0 != +0.0): EXACT_GUARDED vs EXACT_R118 on every controlled step (touched rows), every organic step (touched rows), historical replay through the substrate (8 graphs x 2 transports x 6 checkpoints, NATIVE and R114, H1 and H20), and a kernel differential campaign (3 registry families x 6 checkpoints x 3 controllers x 6 state regimes x 4 trials, 32 instances each)
numerical_verification.oracle_parity: historical replay vs the torch rollout: <= 1e-12 after one pass, <= 1e-10 after 20 (R118-C tolerances)
numerical_verification.covariance: relation-gauge covariance and participant-gauge invariance, end to end with overlapping windows, per mode at scales 1, 1e-104, 1e-157, 1e-300, 1e-310: absolute error (gated at 1e-9 as in R118-C) and error relative to the state scale (reported); negative control (state-only gauge) must exceed 1e-6 relative
numerical_verification.deviation: FTZ_DAZ and STATE_FLUSH vs EXACT_R118: maximum absolute deviation over all controlled and organic steps; bit identity in NORMAL and NEARZERO
numerical_verification.weights: six checkpoint pins unchanged after all runs

classification.EXACT: bit-identical to EXACT_R118 in every numerical verification above, without exception
classification.TOLERANCE_QUALIFIED: not EXACT, but: bit-identical to EXACT_R118 in NORMAL and NEARZERO; maximum absolute deviation <= 2^-1000 (9.33e-302) everywhere; absolute covariance error <= 1e-9 in every tested scale; weights unchanged

decision_rules: The R118-D numerical exception closes for the default exact path iff EXACT_GUARDED is classified EXACT and is latency-qualified; only then does EXACT_GUARDED become the default mode of R119Engine.
Otherwise the exception remains OPEN and the default stays EXACT_R118.
FTZ_DAZ is a separate opt-in operating mode: its disposition is its numerical class plus its latency admission, and it is never evidence that the default exact path passes.
STATE_FLUSH_2P-500 is classified numerically only (negative control).
R118-E remains descriptive; R93 remains ENERGY_NORMALIZED_DENOMINATOR_HOLD; no capacity expansion; learned HCA unmodified.
memory: peak RSS (getrusage ru_maxrss) of each measurement process; engine scratch bytes; no new allocations in either kernel
environment: same host class as R118-D; single thread (OMP/MKL/OPENBLAS=1); torch not imported in latency processes; Python gc enabled
